title: Tiny Sunfish, BIG Attitude #Shorts
description:
Tiny sunfish, BIG attitude. Stop, stop! 😂

Sunrise on a cold front morning at Boerne City Lake. Full video on my channel, @distractedquest.

title: Sunrise Launch, Sunfish & a Creek Run | First Cold Front Kayak Trip
description:
My first fall cold front trip, about 50°F at launch. That counts as cold in Texas 🥶

It starts with the kayak and the trailer, then a sunrise launch on Boerne City Lake in Boerne, TX. The water was 67, down from 85 not that long ago. I get the first small fish of the day, then a sunfish with a big attitude by the reeds. After that I head up the creek for a morning cigar (a Texas Sweets), cast into some moving water, and make a brisk ride back.

Two fish. One cold front.

title: The Cigar Side Quest | Cigars on the Kayak, Zero Fish on Camera
description:
Main quest is fishing, side quest is cigars.

Two mornings on the kayak, a couple of cigars, and zero fish on camera. The cigars took this round 😅

On the first morning I light a breakfast cigar on a moving kayak, scout some points and a cove, and admit I can't pick out tasting notes. I just know what I like. Water temps are finally dropping, and the Connecticut wrapper was nice and gentle.

The second morning is my first cold front trip of the season, with a Texas Sweets on the water and a Montecristo White Label saved for the ride back. It's windy, so don't judge the torch. I also share how this side quest started about 25 years ago, and why the real Cubans I tried in Taiwan never won me over.

Rigs: Texas rig, Ned rig with a paddle tail
